label: Bible Study
prompt: And as Moses lifted up the _____ in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verse: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
note: Jesus points Nicodemus back to Numbers 21 — the brass serpent lifted up for healing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this _____; and I knew it not.
verse: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
note: Jacob wakes from his ladder dream on a stone pillow and realizes God was there all along — he just hadn't noticed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Noah began to be an _____, and he planted a vineyard:
verse: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
note: 'Husbandman' is the KJV's word for farmer — Noah stepped off the ark and went straight back to working the ground.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have _____ the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
note: Temple renovations turned up the forgotten book of the law, and King Josiah's great reforms began.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
verse: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
note: Jeremiah's refining image ends grimly: silver that won't purify is 'reprobate silver,' because the LORD hath rejected it.
